topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution and outlines the expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and transient epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to evolving cell clones.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how tissue stem cell hierarchies and the specific cell of origin influence cancer initiation and tumor propagation across different malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependence in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external promotional stimuli, chronic inflammation, and supportive stromal interactions are required for neoplastic expansion and tumor maintenance.

topics.label: Methodologies for investigating tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the experimental and computational tools used to map and analyse tumor evolution in laboratory and clinical specimens.

topics.label: Integrated model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic alterations, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental factors cooperatively drive malignant progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture session and previews the upcoming topic on cancer therapy.
